code:
[Unit]
Description={{service_name}}
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User={{run_user}}
ExecStart={{exec_path}}
Restart=always
RestartSec=3
LimitNOFILE=65535
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
summary_zh: systemd unit,網路就緒後啟動,崩潰自動重啟
